d:
Jharkhand ki mitti, mandar ki thap aur mundari loknrity ka adbhut sangam!
Jharkhand ke ganvon ki khubsurti, prakriti ki manmohak chhata aur lokjivan ki sahajta men basti hai yahan ki samriddh sanskritik virasta. paharon ke bich base ganv, kachchi pagdandiyan, gramin jivan ki halchal aur loksangit ki madhur dhunen jharkhand ki paranpraon ko jivant banati hain.
Didi jharkhand ke karyakram ‘dhol-mandar’ men dekhie mundari loknrity ki ek khubsurat prastuti, jo jharkhand ki janjatiy sanskriti aur paranprik lokakla ki anuthi jhalak pesh karti hai.
